questions.prompt: What can people discuss in the questionnaire?
options: The good points of change, without possible problems.
The changes already made, rather than future priorities.
Their ideas, worries and hopes about possible changes.
Future changes, without views on how things work now.
questions.explanationZh: 第3至5句同时包括当前组织方式、未来改革重点、问题与机遇，不排除现状或担忧，也不是只评价已完成的改革。

questions.prompt: When can people send their answers online?
options: Until 11 December, as part of the wider discussions.
For three months after the questionnaire was announced.
After the three-month programme of discussions ends.
Once ministers finish talking to councils and unions.
questions.explanationZh: 第6句给出的提交截止日期是12月11日；第7句的三个月指整体讨论计划，并非问卷从发布起开放三个月，也不必等待组织讨论结束。

questions.prompt: What happens after people give their views?
options: The government makes changes before studying the answers.
Public answers take the place of talks with organisations.
The government studies answers after the next stage starts.
The government considers answers alongside other evidence.
questions.explanationZh: 第7至8句表明问卷与组织讨论同时属于更广泛计划；第10句说下一阶段之前考虑意见和证据，并非先改革或进入下一阶段后再研究，也不取代组织讨论。
